top_signals.title: Nvidia’s Show of Financial Force Soothes Credit Markets
top_signals.summary: Six of the biggest names in finance are helping Nvidia Corp. ease some of the investor anxiety that’s been building for weeks over its swelling commitments to backstop the artificial intelligence boom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Syria sentences Bashar Assad to death in absentia over atrocities
top_signals.summary: The ruling is the first of its kind under Syria's transitional leaders, who ousted Assad in 2024, vowing to provide justice and accountability for crimes committed under his rule.
